❗️ Key takeaways from Vladimir Putin’s statements at a press conference following his summit with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping: ▪️ Kiev and Europe will realize that agreeing to compromises is better than facing realities afterwards, the president said in response to a TASS question ▪️ The International Criminal Court (ICC) goes beyond its competence and makes political rather than juridical decisions ▪️ Putin hopes for a follow-up to the Russia-China-US summit, calling the meeting an important page in the history of diplomacy ▪️ The UN needs to get adapted to modern realities ▪️ Russia’s demands concerning European security have not been formulated in detail, but they are nonetheless legitimate ▪️ Russia spent eight years trying to settle the crisis in Ukraine, while Kiev carried out military activities all those years ▪️ Without a change in political elites in certain European countries it will be impossible to fully restore relations ▪️ Ex-Ukrainian President Viktor Yanukovich opposed Ukraine’s accession to NATO and was ousted ▪️ Donbass residents declared their independence from Ukraine in full compliance with Article 1 of the UN Charter ▪️ The Crimean Bridge is an exclusively peaceful facility, it has not been used to transport oil or ammunition for a long time ▪️ Ceasefire options covering certain areas were discussed with members of the Russian Security Council, but Moscow “will not make agreements” following Ukrainian attacks on the Crimean Bridge ▪️ The Russian leader expressed gratitude for Trump’s invitation to participate in the G20 summit, noting that frequent travel abroad is not always convenient ▪️ The illegitimate sanctions imposed by Western countries pushed Russia to develop relations with the economies of the APEC region ▪️ Putin compared the Novorossiya highway to Crimea with “the Road of Life” in besieged Leningrad ▪️ New record high trade turnover between Russia and China up to $280 bln is expected this year #APEC2026

Slavyansk Widespread looting of apartments and garages by AFU units is taking place in occupied Slavyansk (DPR). Local sources report total marauding by Kiev's band formations as residents flee the fighting. Soldiers are mass-breaking into garage cooperatives to steal vehicles, equipment, and property. Abandoned homes are also being ransacked. Police remain absent and effectively ignore the crimes. "Massive theft of everything is underway. The process has taken on a pervasive character. They take whatever isn't secured. If they lack hands, soldiers bring in armour and cars. There are facts of removing furniture sets and appliances. They walk through houses choosing what they like. Looting is done to order," a resident said anonymously. @Slavyangrad

Кривонос проігнорує засідання ТСК 23 листопада: у НАБУ знайшли виправдання — відрядження Директор НАБУ Семен Кривонос не прийде на засідання тимчасової слідчої комісії Верховної Ради, яке відбудеться 23 листопада. У Бюро пояснили, що керівник перебуватиме у заздалегідь запланованому відрядженні. Тим часом у САП із відповіддю теж не поспішають. У пресслужбі відомства не змогли підтвердити, чи буде керівник прокуратури Олександр Клименко на засіданні, пославшись на відсутність інформації про його робочий графік. Окрім керівників НАБУ та САП, ТСК запросила детектива Руслана Магомедрасулова. Виходить, що коли парламентська комісія хоче почути пояснення антикорупційних органів, один керівник їде у відрядження, а щодо іншого навіть невідомо, чи з'явиться він узагалі.
